title: Glyph Garden
subtitle: Draw a mark. See what takes root.
description: Tend an original illustrated garden with circles, chevrons, and zigzags. A bounded local shape recognizer grows flowers and trees or changes the breeze, with honest match scores, three planting patches, keyboard equivalents, undo, and a motion pause.
instruction: Draw a generous circle for a flower, an upright chevron for a tree, or a three-stroke zigzag for wind. Choose a planting patch, or use the field-guide buttons.
